svg.aria-label: Ticket types classify held inventory. Holds contain inventory hold items and each hold has at most one order. Orders contain copied-price order items and payment attempts; sold items issue at most one ticket. Attempts receive provider events and can have refunds. Outbox messages support durable recovery without becoming the inventory or money authority.
svg.title: PROPOSED EXTENSION: PAID CHECKOUT + TICKET ISSUANCE
